consensus: Search attempted; connector requires reauthentication. Official papers and pinned installed implementation used as fallback.

sources.finding: Fine-tuning gains depend on model/data; larger supervised updates can worsen calibration. Does not establish a benefit on Kumo or this competition.

Compact query/key similarity adaptation and selective aggregation were evaluated on other tabular backbones. Query-scaling updates motivate testing a smaller, existing attention-temperature subset. This is a Kumo-specific hypothesis, not a replication claim.
